exposure: uterine artery embolization (UAE) combined with curettage
gestational age of <55 days and a gestational sac diameter of <30 mm
gestational age <60 days and diameter of gestational sac <40 mm
high-intensity focused ultrasound (HIFU) combined with curettage
outcome: decline in the rate of hCG
finding: CSP patients with short gestational age and small gestational sac can be treated with surgery, UAE, and HIFU, and achieve safe and effective therapeutic effects, while surgery is also suitable for CSP for those with a long gestational age, a large gestational sac diameter, high levels of hCG, or ample blood supply.
